newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Number Nine started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Number Nine started.

text.p: --Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Number Nine Visual Technology Corp with a market performer rating. Nine Visual designs proprietary 128-bit graphic accelerators for use on company-designed graphic accelerator boards in computers.

--Rauscher Pierce noted that the company is losing market share to competitors on the merchant technology side of the business. It noted that Number Nine is a one-product company whose stock price will rise and fall with the success of that proprietary product.
